note: Non-compliant behaviour: an AuType 2 packet whose standard-header Checksum is calculated rather than set to 0. TestOSPFPacketChecksumZeroForAuType2 encodes a cryptographic-auth Hello through WriteTo and fails ('AuType2 checksum = %#04x, want 0') on any non-zero field. Single-polarity positive per the row's marker: the rule is generate-side and there is no receive path to reject.
